_comment: FICTIONAL. Caption script for video/overview_explainer.mp4. No speech: these lines are burned in as captions, written to the WebVTT track and to the transcript. Times in seconds. {placeholders} are filled from numbers.json by build.py.
cues: Quillwave is a fictional project, made as synthetic test material.
The task: recover a full {field_size}x{field_size} ripple field from only {sensors} point sensors.
Simple interpolation blurs the wave fronts between the sensors.
Quillwave encodes the sensor readings into a compact latent field code.
A field decoder then predicts a value and a confidence at every pixel.
Left: linear interpolation of the sensors. Right: Quillwave.
The wave fronts stay sharp as the sources move.
On RippleBench-Synthetic, Quillwave reaches {psnr} dB PSNR.
That is {gain} dB above radial-basis interpolation.
Limitations: all results are on synthetic fields only.
The baselines are not compute-matched, and the confidence map is not calibrated.
